g.text: Increment 5 - Reservation Creation with 5-Minute Temporary Hold
Countdown is displayed by the frontend,
but the server enforces the fixed expiresAt.
Failed payment retries do not reset it.
Select room type, dates, guest count, contact details
[Invalid input / duplicate or excessive hold request]
Check capacity across all requested nights
Count Confirmed bookings and unexpired Pending holds
Create/link Guest safely; insert Pending hold
[Each payment attempt while hold remains Pending and unexpired]
Check hold status and server-side expiry
Verify still Pending and now < expiresAt
Change Pending to Expired; release hold; COMMIT
Generate unique reference, random secret and hash
Set Pending -> Confirmed; save reference, code hash,
price snapshot and successful payment record
Reverse payment or flag for reconciliation
Not confirmed; show safe failure message
Mark Pending holds Expired when expiresAt <= now
Availability always excludes expired holds based on server time,
even if the expiry worker has not updated their status yet.
All capacity-consuming holds and confirmed bookings count per night.
